note: Whole-Yangon map landmarks (14 Nov 2026). Real facts from public sources (Wikipedia, operators' pages) and the satellite; positions are the OSM outlines' (build/osm_ygn) unless given. Heights in metres (real); the game builds vertical sizes at the cars' scale (3 studs a metre) for buildings and at least that for monuments. Real names are plain text only, never logos (owner rule). Each entry is built as its own model (not by the generic mesh kit).

landmarks.name: Shwedagon Pagoda
landmarks.facts: Gilded stupa 99 m (325 ft) tall on Singuttara Hill (the platform is about 58 m above sea level); platform about 275 x 220 m, paved marble; the stupa: a square base with 3 terraces, an octagonal tier, the bell, the inverted alms bowl, turban bands, the ornamental lotus petals, the banana bud and the hti umbrella with the vane and diamond orb; 64 small pagodas and 4 larger ones on the base terrace at the cardinal points; dozens of shrine halls (tazaung) with tiered pyatthat roofs round the platform; 4 covered stairways (zaungdan) north, south, east, west with tiered roofs, the south and west ones with lifts; two giant chinthe (lion) guardians at the south entrance on Shwedagon Pagoda Road; the platform is lit gold at night (the most important night view of the city).
landmarks.build: Python lathe mesh for the stupa (golden, emissive at night), the hill as terrain, the platform as a flat stone plate, the small pagodas and tazaungs from 3-4 kits, the 4 stairways as covered ramps; must be visible from far away (far LOD copy in Yangon.Far).

landmarks.name: Sule Pagoda
landmarks.facts: Octagonal gilded stupa 44 m tall in the middle of the Sule roundabout (Sule Pagoda Road / Maha Bandula Road), ringed by small shops at street level; City Hall on its north-east corner, Maha Bandula Park and the Independence Monument (obelisk, 46 m) to its east.

landmarks.name: Yangon City Hall
landmarks.facts: 1936, Burmese-revival style, 4 floors, pale blue-green and white, tiered pyatthat roofs over the corners and the middle, on Maha Bandula Road facing Sule.

landmarks.name: Independence Monument
landmarks.facts: White obelisk 46 m tall in Maha Bandula Park, five smaller pillars round it.

landmarks.name: The Strand Hotel
landmarks.facts: 1901, 3 floors, white and cream Victorian facade with a central portico, on Strand Road facing the river.

landmarks.name: Secretariat
landmarks.facts: Red-brick Victorian complex (1889-1905), 2-3 floors with towers and a central dome, a big rectangle round courtyards, on Theinbyu Road.

landmarks.name: Bogyoke Aung San Market
landmarks.facts: 1926, colonial market halls with cobbled streets, a clock tower, ochre and white with red/green roofs, on Bogyoke Aung San Road.

landmarks.name: Yangon Central Railway Station
landmarks.facts: 1954, Burmese-style with tiered pyatthat roofs over a long hall, the tracks (Yangon Circular Railway) in a cutting north of downtown; Pansodan Bridge crosses the tracks.

landmarks.name: Botataung Pagoda
landmarks.facts: Gilded stupa 40 m on the riverfront (Strand Road), hollow inside.

landmarks.name: Karaweik Palace
landmarks.facts: Concrete replica of a royal barge on Kandawgyi Lake: two golden karaweik birds at the bow, a tall tiered pyatthat spire in the middle, gold and red, lit at night; a wooden boardwalk round the lake's west side.

landmarks.name: Chaukhtatgyi Buddha Temple
landmarks.facts: A 66 m long reclining Buddha under a big open-sided steel shed with a metal roof (white body, gold robe, the feet with 108 marks); monastery buildings round it on Shwe Gone Dine Road.

landmarks.name: Nga Htat Gyi Pagoda
landmarks.facts: Across the road from Chaukhtatgyi: a 14 m seated Buddha inside a tiered-roof hall.

landmarks.name: Kaba Aye Pagoda
landmarks.facts: 1952, gilded stupa 34 m tall on a hill, hollow inside, with the Maha Pasana Guha (a big man-made cave hall) beside it.

landmarks.name: Maha Wizaya Pagoda
landmarks.facts: 1980s gilded stupa about 40 m on the hill south of Shwedagon, across U Htaung Bo Road.

landmarks.name: People's Park
landmarks.facts: Big park west of Shwedagon with lawns, a fountain and a retired airliner on display; People's Square in front.

landmarks.name: Yangon Zoological Gardens
landmarks.facts: Walled zoo park with trees and ponds south-west of Kandawgyi Lake, the main gate on Zoological Garden Road.

landmarks.name: University of Yangon Convocation Hall
landmarks.facts: Red-brick and white colonial hall with a clock tower in the university campus by Pyay Road; Judson Church and the red-roofed campus halls around.

landmarks.name: Inya Lake Hotel
landmarks.facts: 1962 hotel on the lake's east shore off Kabar Aye Pagoda Road, long low block in gardens.

landmarks.name: Junction City
landmarks.facts: Mall with a 25-floor office tower (2017) on Bogyoke Aung San Road, glass and stone.

landmarks.name: Sakura Tower
landmarks.facts: 20-floor office tower (1999) on Bogyoke Aung San Road / Sule Pagoda Road, blue glass.

landmarks.name: Sule Shangri-La
landmarks.facts: 22-floor hotel tower (formerly Traders), on Sule Pagoda Road.

landmarks.name: Pan Pacific Yangon
landmarks.facts: 23-floor hotel tower at Junction City.
